newsitem.title: UK: Jardinerie Interiors to list on AIM via placing.
newsitem.headline: Jardinerie Interiors to list on AIM via placing.

text.p: Jardinerie Interiors Group Plc said on Monday it was seeking admission to the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) by means of a placing.
Jardinerie said the placing, at 114p, would raise up to 4.3 million stg and value the company, which provides interior landscaping services and plant rental and maintenance, at 10.2 million stg.
Most of the funds raised will fund the acquisition of two companies, Tropical Plants Display and Office Landscaping.
"Research shows there is an increasing awareness of the benefits that plants have to both personnel and the environment," said chief executive William Braid.
"It is the very fragmented nature of the market that offers the group the greatest growth potential and we are confident that the group's prospects are good."
The adviser to the issue is Deloitte & Touche Corporate Finance. Burrough Johnstone will act as broker.
